'''Abridon''' was a pleasant, mountainous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with special significance to the career of [[Brenn Tantor]]. Its [[Abridon capital city|capital]] housed the [[Abridon Government Center]], while [[Sayan]] was the center of its [[Abridon Shipyard|shipbuilding industry]]. It was primarily notable to [[The galaxy/Legends|the greater galaxy]] as the site of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] capture by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was located on the Northern Corridor's [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]].

==History==
Around the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Abridon Nationalists]] [[Uprising on Abridon|took control of the planet]] with the cooperation of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] armed forces. Five Rebel diplomats, including Skywalker, arrived in order to convince the [[Abridon Government Council|planet's Government Council]] to join the Alliance.

Three days later, their efforts were interrupted when the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Inquisitor (Star Destroyer)|''Inquisitor'']] arrived. [[Grand General/Legends|Grand General]] [[Malcor Brashin]] oversaw the [[Massacre on Abridon|reconquest of the planet]]. His subordinate, General [[Brenn Tantor]], led a strong force that retook the capital city, captured Skywalker and the rest of the diplomats, and drove the Rebels, led by General [[Tyr Taskeen]], off-planet. Brashin also ordered the destruction of a [[Abridon refugee camp|refugee camp]] near the final Rebel position, but Tantor refused the order. Brashin stripped Tantor of command and ordered Tantor's forces to destroy the camp, telling them it was full of Rebels.

However, Nationalist resistance remained, concentrated in Sayan. The continual fighting in the city grew so bad that after several months, the Empire finally gave up hope of holding it and began to simply bombard it to dust.

[[File:Govt_Mound.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Abridon Government Center|capitol]] of Abridon]]
Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Rebel Alliance heeded the Nationalists' call for relief. They sent Taskeen back to Abridon. [[Liberation of Abridon|This time]], Tantor would be unable to stop him. Tantor had in fact defected to the Alliance after the massacre, and now led Taskeen's forces to victory, retaking the capital, freeing a [[Abridon holding camp|prison camp]], and destroying the Imperial presence in Sayan. The planet was now free to join the Alliance, which it did under the leadership of Nationalist [[Hamman Flatt]]. The new government's first act was to release a squadron of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] interceptors to the Alliance, which would be put to good use in the Battle of Endor.
